name: Endive (Escarole)

schedule.notes: Fall is the easier season; mild temperatures make milder leaves.
Tie outer leaves over the heart 2 weeks before cutting to blanch (sweeten) the inner leaves.

harvest.cues: Head 8 to 10 in across, firm. Cut at the soil line.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge crisper in plastic 1 week. Blanched leaves don't keep as long as unblanched.

varieties.name: Frisée
varieties.notes: Frilly outer leaves, blanched yellow center. The bistro salad.

varieties.name: Broad-leaved Escarole
varieties.notes: Flat dark leaves. Excellent in soups and stews.

notes: Bitter raw, mellows with cooking or blanching. Hold off harvest in summer heat — bitterness intensifies. Frost actually sweetens the leaves.
